summary: Biological ODE models are public (BioModels) and the authors' MATLAB scripts for randomising and removing edges and evaluating memory are on GitHub (GRN_ODE, unlicensed). The rule for assigning kinetic parameters to added edges and the exact model list are not documented in any dataset I could open.
next_step: Read the GRN_ODE scripts to extract the model IDs, the edge-edit rule and the memory metric, then pre-register the biological-vs-random comparison.
obstacles_confirmed: No record documents how new edges get kinetic parameters; it has to be read from the code or paper.
Random-network controls are generated by code, not deposited as a dataset.
